title: Identity Reference-Dereference Operations
pattern: Writing ref-deref combinations (`*&` or `&*`) where the final type remains exactly the same.
why_bad: It is completely redundant, adding cognitive scanning cost and visual boilerplate that resolves to an identity operation.
detection: A reference operator immediately nested inside a dereference operator (or vice-versa) returning the original value type.
counterexample: Context-dependent (occasionally required in complex macro expansions to force specific coercion rules).
fix: Remove both the reference and dereference operators.
